result.requirement: The system shall ingest real-time operational data from external logistics providers to monitor fleet availability and route constraints.
result.business_need: The business needs this to dynamically adjust delivery capacity and fees based on live network status, preventing service degradation during congestion.
functional_behaviour: The system shall establish secure, bi-directional data links with registered Payment Providers and Delivery Partners.
The system shall ingest live telemetry regarding agent location, speed, and current workload status.
The system shall update the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot to reflect temporary unavailability caused by network disruptions.
The system shall recalculate estimated travel duration and distance based on current traffic patterns and route constraints.
The system shall flag Delivery Assignment records when external network status prevents meeting the assigned Delivery Slot.
The system shall expose network congestion metrics to the Fulfillment Supervisor for workload balancing.
related_information_requirements: Live visibility into the location, speed, and status of all active delivery agents
Calculated estimates of travel duration and distance accounting for traffic patterns
Status of the data link between the store and the platform including latency
Aggregate capacity of the fleet within the service zone
business_rules: The system shall treat a data link latency exceeding the defined threshold as a network disruption.
The system shall invalidate an Assigned Delivery Slot if the external network status indicates a route constraint.
The system shall update the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot to mark items as unavailable if the logistics link is down.
The system shall prioritize agents with lower workload status when assigning tasks during network congestion.

acceptance_criteria.given: The external logistics provider reports a route constraint due to traffic
acceptance_criteria.when: The system ingests this real-time data
acceptance_criteria.then: The system updates the travel duration estimate and flags the affected Delivery Assignment

acceptance_criteria.given: The data link between the store and the platform experiences high latency
acceptance_criteria.when: The system detects this status exceeds the defined threshold
acceptance_criteria.then: The system marks the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot as unreliable and alerts the Fulfillment Supervisor
